1. Open your profile, see your results
slides.caption: CGPA, SGPA and every subject's grade.

slides.title: Nobody types your GPA
slides.body: When your teacher finalises the course in the gradebook, your result is saved and your GPA is worked out automatically.

slides.title: Your college's own scale
slides.body: Grade bands and credit weighting are set once by your college, so the maths matches your marksheet rules. Not a random online calculator.

slides.title: Skip the spreadsheet
slides.body: No credits x grade points formula, no 6-tab Excel sheet before internals. Spend that time on Maggi. Or sleep.

slides.title: Graduated? Still yours
slides.body: Alumni can still see their term results and GPA. Handy when that job form asks for your CGPA.

slides.title: Want this on your campus? Tag your college
slides.body: 30-day free trial for colleges, no card needed.
